summary: Pre-Move Guardian bug fixes tested successfully. All 34 tests passed (17 new unit tests + 17 existing API tests). Bug fixes verified: (1) When in check, guardian returns no intervention with in_check=true detail, (2) Good captures like bishop takes rook do not warn about hanging piece, (3) Bad trades still trigger warnings correctly, (4) Defending/blocking threats does not trigger false IGNORE_THREAT warnings.
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - unit tests use FEN positions directly, API tests use dev login
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pre-Move Guardian bug fixes verified with comprehensive unit tests. New test file test_guardian_bugfixes.py covers: (1) TestInCheckNoWarnings - 3 tests verify no intervention when user is in check, (2) TestGoodCapturesNoWarning - 4 tests verify bishop takes rook and similar good trades don't warn, (3) TestBadTradesStillWarn - 2 tests verify bad trades still trigger warnings, (4) TestDefendingThreatNoWarning - 2 tests verify defending/capturing attacker works correctly, (5) TestGivingCheckNoWarning - 1 test verifies giving check doesn't trigger hanging warning, (6) TestConvenienceFunction - 2 tests for evaluate_move_for_guardian(), (7) TestEdgeCases - 3 tests for error handling and processing time.

backend: Bug Fix #1: When in check, evaluate_move() returns no intervention with details.in_check=true

Giving check bypasses hanging piece warning
Invalid FEN/move handled gracefully with error details
